name: Munami Shiroto
source:
Senpai of the protagonist. He's a gentle and caring mood-maker. He works at the same company as her as a therapist. His daily life is a mystery, and he often appears out of nowhere. It seems that his principle is to not to use chimes.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211229112616/https://blessing-string.com/]official website[/url]]
